extractOutfit.unsupportedCategoryMessage: Outfit extraction is only available for headwear, upperwear, lowerwear, and footwear products.
extractOutfit.fullBodyPrompt: Extract the complete outfit from the subject in the image and change the background to a plain color that does not exist in the outfit. Remove the person. Include the full wearable outfit from top to bottom only.

categoryPrompts.headwear: Extract the head outfit from the subject in the image and change the background to a plain color that does not exist in the outfit. Remove the person. Only include the head outfit.
categoryPrompts.upperwear: Extract the upper outfit from the subject in the image and change the background to a plain color that does not exist in the outfit. Remove the person. Only include the upper outfit.
categoryPrompts.lowerwear: Extract the lower outfit from the subject in the image and change the background to a plain color that does not exist in the outfit. Remove the person. Only include the lower outfit.
categoryPrompts.footwear: Extract the foot outfit from the subject in the image and change the background to a plain color that does not exist in the outfit. Remove the person. Only include the foot outfit.

virtualTryOn.unsupportedCategoryMessage: Virtual try-on is only available for headwear, upperwear, lowerwear, and footwear products.
virtualTryOn.fullBodyPrompt: Replace the complete outfit of the person in image 1 with the full outfit shown in image 2. Do not change the hairstyle, face and body features, pose angle, and background.

categoryPrompts.headwear: Replace the headwear of the person in image 1 with the headwear shown in image 2. Do not change the hairstyle, face and body features, pose angle, and background.
categoryPrompts.upperwear: Replace the upper body clothing of image 1 with the clothing in image 2. Do not change the hairstyle, face and body features, pose angle, and background. Do not modify the rest of the outfit.
categoryPrompts.lowerwear: Replace the lower body clothing of image 1 with the clothing in image 2. Do not change the hairstyle, face and body features, pose angle, and background. Do not modify the rest of the outfit.
categoryPrompts.footwear: Replace the footwear of image 1 with the wearable footwear in image 2. Do not change the hairstyle, face and body features, pose angle, and background. Do not modify the rest of the outfit.
